body:
OC-DEV-001 reconciles the full product against main `ffe5ac285ab8aef33a1139bce6f3da79be3d6d33` and draft PR #80 `958193f266c89302b2f1919e3703faece591e0af`. This documentation-only branch starts from main; it does not incorporate or modify PR #80's unmerged implementation.

The package under `docs/verification/oc-dev-001/` contains the nine requested deliverables plus JSON/provenance, source/symbol inventories, raw bounded-test logs and SHA-256 manifests. It reconciles 158 unique registered IDs (including historical/proposal IDs, not 158 approved features), preserves 31 included journeys/30 unrecovered definitions, and proposes 55 dependency-ordered backlog items: 33 coding, 8 decisions, 6 external qualification, 2 formal UAT and 6 verification. Five candidate development sprints are proposed; none is started.

Classifications: 14 bounded automated verified, 13 test gap, 27 partial, 2 not implemented, 5 externally blocked, 31 authority pending, 62 source unrecovered, 4 excluded/superseded. Each ID has one primary module, immutable source references, main-versus-draft disposition and test/evidence boundaries. Global RM-DEF-036 performance and RM-DEF-039 centralized collector administration are explicit; historical defect status is not inferred from issue titles or merges.

Actual new checks: 61 guarded backend contracts PASS on each baseline; Node helper/source tests main38/38 and PR80 46/46; PR80 Pentaho/authority offline60/60; traceability56 IDs/31 journeys/nine approvals PASS; audit validation158 IDs/55 backlog records/39 historical defects/acyclic graph/CSV-JSON equality/provenance/links PASS. Counts overlap. No mounted-component, new PG/browser/load/genuine-provider or formal UAT claim. Failed audit-generation/validator attempts are preserved.

Observed hosted baseline CI: main8 success/3 skipped/1 failed `publish` at main/approved-PR preflight before build; detailed log unavailable, root cause unresolved. PR80 18/18 SUCCESS. No publication rerun or guard bypass. New documentation-PR checks, if triggered, are reported separately.

Preserve centralized PostgreSQL durable-spool direction; exact transaction/retention source recovery is an explicit dependency, not permission to select an alternative. D07/D08 and all nine current owner selections remain Pending; historical controlled-scope approvals unchanged. Genuine Pentaho qualification remains BLOCKED. Collector0.123.0 pin unchanged. No product feature/schema changes, deployment, merge, real-provider access, live UAT or OC-DEV-002 execution.

**CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO.**

Owner review requested for the reconciliation and proposed sprint scope only. OC-DEV-002 is NOT AUTHORIZED/NOT STARTED. All release/security/reliability gates and Pending selections remain unchanged.
